blocks.text: Managing press release distribution on Mac

Your Mac is the command center for your entire PR strategy. Press release distribution involves constant switching between media databases, email clients, and document editors. This context switching kills your momentum. You likely spend hours every week moving data from a platform like Muck Rack or Meltwater into your email drafts. You can reduce this friction by using your voice to interact with your apps.

When you hold the fn key to dictate, you can draft personalized pitches without typing every word. If you need to find a specific setting in your email client or a CRM, hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask Lazur where that button lives. It will circle the interface element on your screen. This keeps your hands on the keyboard and your eyes on your work.
How to handle media monitoring and research

Media monitoring is a constant task. You need to stay updated on brand mentions and competitor news. Instead of manually searching through dozens of browser tabs, you can use Lazur to perform background research. When you are in Chrome, ask Lazur to summarize recent coverage for a specific client. It runs the search in its own tabs and presents a report to you.
Reducing email fatigue in your PR workflow

Email is the biggest time sink for PR managers. You are constantly reactive, checking for replies or breaking news. The average knowledge worker spends 28 percent of their week in their inbox. If you get interrupted by a notification, it takes 23 minutes to get back to deep work. Use voice dictation for your initial email drafts to get thoughts out faster. Keep your inbox clean by using keyboard shortcuts for archiving and moving messages.

blocks.text: You should treat your Mac as an extension of your professional self. Use the built in tools like Automator for routine file renaming or image conversion. If you find yourself doing a task more than three times a day, look for a shortcut. Lazur can help you find those settings. Hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask how to enable a feature you heard about. It will guide you through the menu paths.

As a PR professional, you handle sensitive information and client data. You must follow your employer rules regarding data privacy. Lazur processes your audio and screen content only while you hold the shortcut key. None of your content is stored on remote servers or used to train AI models. This ensures you can work on confidential pitches without worrying about data leakage.

faq.question: Can Lazur send emails for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or operate other apps for you. It helps you draft text and guides you through your Mac interface.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with PR software like Muck Rack?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur works in any app on your Mac. You can use it to dictate notes while looking at your media lists or to find specific buttons within those platforms.

faq.question: Is my client data safe when using voice commands?
faq.answer: Lazur does not store your screen content or audio. It processes information only while you hold the shortcut key and does not use your data for training.
